name: connect-request-names
description: Join requests with the longest allowed device name (63 characters) on the Connect screen: at 120 columns the name shows in full, at 80 it ends in an ellipsis and 'wants to join' stays, and the accept notice follows the same rule and names the network (laptop-kollab-net); no row wraps (issue #121, Story 1). The requests are canned by tests/tmux/lib/connect_canned_requests.py because a spec has no second device or relay.

setup.description: throwaway HOME with a workspace on an offline network
setup.command: R=$(pwd); H="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-connect-request-names"; rm -rf "$H"; mkdir -p "$H/.kollab" "$H/ws"; printf '%s' '{"kollabor":{"llm":{"active_profile":"openai-test","profiles":{"openai-test":{"provider":"openai","model":"gpt-5.5","base_url":"https://api.openai.com/v1","api_key":"sk-test-dummy","supports_tools":true}}}},"plugins":{"hub":{"enabled":true}}}' > "$H/.kollab/config.json"; ln -sfn "$R/plugins" "$H/ws/plugins"; cd "$H/ws" && HOME="$H" PYTHONPATH="$R" "$R/.venv/bin/python" -c "from plugins.hub.project_scope import resolve_project_root as root; from plugins.hub.relay_state import RelayStateStore as Store; s = Store(root(), None); s.state.origin = 'https://relay.invalid'; s.state.device_name = 'laptop-kollab'; s.state.network_name = 'laptop-kollab-net'; s.save()"; touch "$H/.kollab/connect-guide-seen"
